proposals.evidence: Turner identifies Hindi gayā, Nepali/Kumaoni gayo and Old Gujarati gyau/giu as suppletive preterites of go from gata. These survey gV(y)- forms preserve that gone/past stem even though the elicitation gloss is simply go. Forms retaining an l expansion are assigned to the separate *gatailla branch.
